metadata.title: IP Routing and Neighbor Resolution
metadata.subject: NCC — Net-Centric Computing
metadata.contentType: Original practice based on the accompanying lecture notes

source.section: Section 8 — IP addressing routing and forwarding

questions.sentence: The local forwarding choice among matching routes uses the ___ prefix match.
questions.explanation: More prefix bits give a more specific matching entry.

source.section: Section 8 — IP addressing routing and forwarding

questions.sentence: For a remote destination, the first frame normally targets the default ___ MAC address.
hints: The local router used as next hop.
questions.explanation: The packet retains the remote host IP destination.

source.section: Section 8 — IP addressing routing and forwarding

questions.sentence: The IPv4 field that prevents indefinite forwarding loops is ___.
questions.explanation: Routers decrement it and can discard packets when it expires.

source.section: Section 8 — IP addressing routing and forwarding

questions.sentence: The IPv4 Protocol number for TCP is ___.
questions.explanation: The field directs IP payload processing to TCP.

source.section: Section 8 — IP addressing routing and forwarding

questions.sentence: An IPv4 header with IHL 5 occupies ___ bytes.
questions.explanation: IHL uses 32-bit words, so a value of 5 means a 20-byte IPv4 header.

source.section: Section 8 — IP addressing routing and forwarding

questions.sentence: The IPv6 base header occupies ___ bytes.
hints: Twice the minimum IPv4 header length.
questions.explanation: Extension headers can add further bytes.

source.section: Section 8 — IP addressing routing and forwarding

questions.sentence: IPv6 replaces the IPv4 TTL field with ___.
hints: Two words naming the hop counter.
questions.explanation: Forwarding routers decrease the IPv6 hop counter.

source.section: Section 9 — ARP and IPv6 Neighbor Discovery

questions.sentence: The IPv4-to-MAC local resolution protocol is ___.
questions.explanation: ARP discovers a local neighbor link address.

source.section: Section 9 — ARP and IPv6 Neighbor Discovery

questions.sentence: Neighbor Discovery uses ___ rather than ARP for IPv6.
questions.explanation: Neighbor Solicitation and Advertisement are ICMPv6 messages.

source.section: Section 9 — ARP and IPv6 Neighbor Discovery

questions.sentence: An Ethernet ARP request commonly uses destination ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff, which is a ___ address.
hints: It reaches all interfaces in the relevant LAN.
questions.explanation: Routers do not normally forward this LAN broadcast across subnets.

source.section: Section 8 — IP addressing routing and forwarding

questions.sentence: A mapping from private 10.0.0.10:49152 to public 192.0.2.50:62001 illustrates address-and-port ___.
questions.explanation: A NAT tracks the mapping and rewrites return traffic.

source.section: Section 9 — ARP and IPv6 Neighbor Discovery

questions.sentence: An IPv4 host can learn configuration such as its address and gateway through ___.
questions.explanation: The running example assumes configuration already exists.
